rules.search_action: Use an action to make a Wisdom (Perception) check against the fixture’s notice/detection DC to find a concealed trap, lock detail, hidden chest, secret latch, or concealed object.
rules.passive_perception: Passive Perception can provide a warning that something is wrong, but this game still requires the active Perception roll before safely manipulating a chest, bookshelf, trapped door, or secret passage.
rules.authored_trap_card: If a fixture has trap_ref/card_ref, reveal that exact Trap card after detection or triggering. Otherwise draw the top random Trap card when the fixture is marked trapped.
rules.disarm_action: Use a Utilize action and make a Dexterity check using Thieves’ Tools against the authored disable DC; default DC 15 when no DC is supplied.
rules.lockpick_action: Picking a lock is separate from disarming its trap: make a Dexterity check using Thieves’ Tools against the authored lock DC; default DC 15 when none is supplied.
order_for_locked_and_trapped_fixture: Pick, force, magically open, or bypass lock
rules.help: A nearby proficient ally can take the Help action to grant Advantage on the next applicable skill or tool check.
rules.crowbar: A crowbar grants Advantage on Strength checks where leverage applies.
rules.brute_force_house_rule: Without Thieves’ Tools, a character may attempt Strength (Athletics) against lock DC + 3. The attempt is noisy, cannot delicately disarm the trap, may damage contents, and may activate a monster trigger.
rules.failure: A failed disarm normally triggers the trap. A failed lockpick jams or alarms the fixture only when its card or authored data says so.

fixture_investigation.chests: Every chest uses Search → trap resolution → lock resolution → Treasure draw/reveal. Authored contents are revealed as their listed Treasure cards; an unspecified chest draws the top Treasure card.

bookshelves.sequence: Search for traps or hidden mechanisms. On a trapped result, resolve a Trap card; on a monster-ambush result, draw and spawn from the Monster deck. After safe resolution, draw from the Treasure deck or reveal the authored room reward.
bookshelves.library_spider: The attached Library bookshelf search can activate the authored hidden spider at L13.

fixture_investigation.weapon_racks: Search/investigate the rack, resolve its monster or trap trigger, then draw one Armory Weapon card.

public_card_safety: Fixture states and placements are never printed on public Room, Character, or Evidence cards.
